expectations.text: Law No. 91/2025/QH15 (PDPL) — the substantive law, in force January 1, 2026
expectations.evidence: No Law No. 91/2025/QH15 or 1 Jan 2026 date; only "The National Assembly passed the PDPL, with an effective date generally reported as taking hold in 2026"

expectations.text: Decree 356/2025/ND-CP (Dec 31, 2025) — implementing detail: PDPIA/CTIA dossier forms, DPO criteria, submission timelines
expectations.evidence: No Decree 356/2025; says only "Implementing decrees/circulars to operationalize the PDPL are expected"

expectations.text: Decree 330/2026/ND-CP (August 19, 2026, effective immediately) — the administrative sanctions layer completing the enforcement mechanism
expectations.evidence: No Decree 330/2026; sanctions layer absent ("the new fine structure" left unspecified)

expectations.text: Transition rule: violations before August 19, 2026 are judged under the law in force at the time unless Decree 330 is more lenient
Identifies MPS/A05 (Department of Cyber Security and High-Tech Crime Prevention) as the enforcement authority
expectations.evidence: "primarily the Ministry of Public Security's cybersecurity and data protection department (successor to/aligned with A05/A06)"
